description: Returns cookieless visitor numbers for a site (views, visitors, how many people made contact; on paid plans the buttons and links visitors tapped, top pages, sources, countries, devices), for as many days back as the plan keeps. Taps are counted only for visitors in the UK (taps_not_counted).

compare.description: Also return the previous period of the same length (paid plans)

days.description: Days back from today, today included (default 7)

recent.description: Also return recent_events, counts per event over the last 30 minutes (to check a test tap)

name: get_analytics
title: Get visitor numbers
